definitions.gloss: curse; divine punishment; wrath of a spirit or deity
definitions.explanation: Supernatural punishment or misfortune believed to be caused by an angry god, spirit, or deceased person. A core concept in Japanese folk religion.
Negative consequences resulting from a past action, used figuratively without literal supernatural meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祟|たた}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧。

⟦{村人|むらびと}→村人：13062_murabito⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{祠|ほこら}→祠：13837_hokora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}した→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{祟|たた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じていた→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: The villagers believed that destroying the old shrine was the cause of the curse.

examples.english: The ill effects of an unhealthy lifestyle in my youth are showing up now.

notes:
Deeply rooted in Japanese folk religion and Shinto belief. A {祟|たた}り is understood as punishment from a supernatural being — a god, spirit, or the dead — that has been angered or disrespected. It is distinct from a deliberate curse cast by a person.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祟|たた}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a curse
- {祟|たた}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to suffer a curse
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祟|たた}り: divine punishment
- ⟦{怨霊|おんりょう}→怨霊：13454_onryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祟|たた}り: curse of a vengeful spirit
- {祟|たた}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧: to fear a curse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{呪|のろ}い→呪い：15822_noroi⟧: curse — a curse intentionally cast by a person, unlike {祟|たた}り which comes from supernatural beings
- ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧: punishment — general punishment, not necessarily supernatural
- ⟦{天罰|てんばつ}→天罰：19475_tenbatsu⟧: divine punishment — emphasizes punishment from heaven for moral wrongdoing

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous examples include the {祟|たた}り of {菅原道真|すがわらのみちざね}, the exiled scholar whose angry spirit was believed to cause disasters in Kyoto, and the curse associated with disturbing ancient burial sites.
